# CI policy agreement waivers (Phase 2–3 of design #7089).
#
# Format: <workflow-file> <leg> <phase-issue>
#   leg is basic | main | nightly
#
# Each waiver names the live phase issue that owns the disagreement.
# The checker requires every issue here to be one of the four Phase 2–3
# issues below and to be open: closing an issue retires its waiver in
# the same change. A waiver for a workflow no longer in disagreement
# fails as stale.
#
# Phase 2:
#   #6929  mcpx-fix-test-guard — dispatch-only; basic + main triggers gone
#   #6953  opencode-config-guard — PR-only; main trigger gone
# Phase 3:
#   #6959  production-line-guard — dispatch-only; basic + main triggers gone
#   #6981  go-modules-build, identity-build, map-build, mcpx-nixbuild —
#          dispatch-only; basic + main triggers gone

.github/workflows/opencode-config-guard.yml main #6953
